application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

units_released.note: Rule: the 16 field packs; laboratory cells and packs are held but not units. Released unit identifiers require package-specific inspection.

cells_liion.source: V1 to V416 in each of the 16 field packs' converted time series, through fielddata.loaders.cell_to_pack

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.source: V1 to V416 in each of the 16 field packs' converted time series, through fielddata.loaders.cell_to_pack

energy_mwh.note: Present usable energy computed from the data: coulomb counting over runs of at least 40 points of SOC with no gap over 300 s, ampere-hours per 100 percent SOC times mean pack voltage, median per unit, summed.

energy_basis.source: energy_mwh is computed from the released data

span_unit_years.note: The release has no calendar timestamps.

obs_hours.note: no calendar dates in the release: service time is observation-hours, the recorded duration of every cycle of the 16 field packs, summed; laboratory cells and packs are held but not units

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20132842; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
